description: Implementation of ClientSocketPoolManager for managing socket pools, including creation, error handling, and info serialization within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: ClientSocketPoolManagerImpl
classes.description: Manages socket pools for network connections, supporting creation, error flushing, closing idle sockets, and info serialization.

methods.name: ClientSocketPoolManagerImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket pool manager with connection parameters and pool type.

methods.name: FlushSocketPoolsWithError
methods.description: Flushes all socket pools with a specified error.

methods.name: CloseIdleSockets
methods.description: Closes all idle sockets in all pools.

methods.name: GetSocketPool
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a socket pool for a given proxy server.

methods.name: SocketPoolInfoToValue
methods.description: Serializes socket pool information into a value list.
